label: R21-ITER-ROUND-METADATA

implementation.summary: round_pack_iter_p1 now consumes only the lead/lead_valid metadata already registered by DIV/SQRT finish; the duplicate descending 256-bit leading-one fallback is removed.
changed_logic: Removed the local fallback-scan loop and its loop index declaration from round_pack_iter_p1.
lead_valid=1 selects pre.lead; lead_valid=0 remains the registered zero classification.
Special bypass, p1 normalization/GRS construction, p2 rounding, flags and FSM states are unchanged.

producer_contract.div_finish_pre: finite nonzero quotient sets sig, lead=leading_one_index(q_sig), lead_valid=(|q_sig != 0); zero/special cases remain special or lead_valid=0
producer_contract.sqrt_finish_pre: finite nonzero quotient sets sig, lead=leading_one_index(q_sig), lead_valid=(|q_sig != 0); zero/special cases remain special or lead_valid=0
producer_contract.consumer: round_pack_iter_p1 uses the registered metadata without rescanning pre.sig

semantic_invariants: H/S/D normal and tiny p1 payloads preserve exponent, mantissa, guard, sticky and discarded bits.
lead_valid=0 produces the same zero p1/p2 result under the finish metadata contract.
Special bits and input flags bypass p1 magnitude work and remain ORed by p2.
IT_FIN -> IT_PACK -> IT_PACK_RESULT state/latency and exactly-once output ownership are untouched.
No public port, state enum, reset/kill/pause logic, latency table, QEMU, QSF or SDC changed.

runs.command: sed -n '/function automatic fp_round_mid_t round_pack_iter_p1/,/endfunction/p' rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv | if rg -n 'for[[:space:]]*\(|pre\.sig\[i\]|integer i'; then exit 1; else echo 'PASS round_pack_iter_p1 has no fallback scan'; fi
runs.notes: The function retains only the metadata-driven h assignment; unrelated any_low_bits calls are part of GRS construction.
